create.name: Devon Kerns
create.bio:
Devon Kerns is a Denver-based coach, teacher and musician who came to this work after more than twenty-five years in business and leadership development. He created Celebrate First, an approach that brings music, movement and mindfulness together, and much of his teaching starts in the body: a few slow breaths, a song or simple movement, then an honest look at what is really going on. His coaching centres on the space between what people already sense they want and how they are actually living, and on the fear, overthinking and borrowed expectations that keep that space open.

He works privately with clients over Zoom in six- and twelve-month terms, each session moving from seeing a situation clearly to choosing one concrete step for the week ahead. A second tier for founders and leaders adds in-person visits and quarterly sessions with the people around them. On Insight Timer he leads guided practices and regular live gatherings such as Stillness Today, and on YouTube he has shared a long daily series on grounding and the root chakra. His short book HERE. I AM (2026) sets out a daily rhythm of breath, movement and return, and he also speaks at conferences, coaching volunteers live on stage.

books.title: HERE. I AM
books.author: Devon K. Kerns
books.description: A short practice book published in 2026 that works more like a daily exercise than a read. It leads you through a simple cycle of breathing, moving and coming back to yourself, so that choices are made from a settled place rather than in reaction.

courses.title: The Expansion: private coaching with Devon Kerns
courses.description: Six or twelve months of one-to-one coaching on Zoom, with 12 or 24 sessions booked whenever you need them, messaging between sessions, a monthly reflection question and a midpoint review. It begins with a free conversation to check the fit.

courses.title: The Legacy: coaching for leaders
courses.description: A by-application programme for people whose work carries others, such as founders and heads of families or teams. Sessions are as frequent as needed, Devon travels for time in person, and every quarter there is a longer session that can include partners, family or colleagues.

free_resources.title: Devon Kerns on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Devon's grounding meditations, short music-led video practices and replays of his live Stillness sessions. Free to hear in the app or on the web, with regular live gatherings too.
